events.description:
Called with the typed text when the user picks the create-new row. It may return the new record, which is then
picked, or nothing, when the app handles the result itself. A rejection picks nothing, and the app reports it
(ADR 0139). The row shows only when `createLabel` is also given.
events.name: onCreate

events.description: Called with the new value each time the user changes it.
events.name: onChange

props.description: One record at a time. This is the default.
props.name: selectionMode

props.description: Not used: a single choice has no tag to remove.
props.name: removeLabel

props.description:
Answers a search: the page of records that match `search` (an empty string asks for the first records), or the
page after `cursor`. A picker asks again when the user pauses typing and ignores an answer that a later request
has replaced. A rejection shows `loadErrorMessage` in the list; typing again asks again.
props.name: loadOptions

props.description: Text shown while the field is empty; it hints at what to pick and never replaces the label.
props.name: placeholder

props.description: True to fill the width of the parent instead of a fixed field width.
props.name: isFullWidth

props.description: How long, in milliseconds, the user must stop typing before a search starts. Defaults to 250.
props.name: debounceMs

props.description: The spoken name of the spinner while records load, for example "Loading people"; without it the spinner is silent.
props.name: loadingLabel

props.description: What the list says when no record matches, for example "No people found"; without it the list stays closed.
props.name: emptyMessage

props.description: What the list says when `loadOptions` rejects, for example "People could not be loaded. Type to try again."
props.name: loadErrorMessage

props.description: The text of the create-new row from the typed text, for example `(text) => \`Add "${text}"\``.
props.name: createLabel

props.description: The visible label; it is the field's accessible name, so a field without one needs the runtime's own name prop.
props.name: label

props.description: Help text under the field, tied to it for assistive technology.
props.name: description

props.description: What is wrong, shown under the field while `isInvalid` is true, and read out with the field.
props.name: errorMessage

props.description: True when the form cannot be submitted without a value; the label shows it and assistive technology is told.
props.name: isRequired

props.description: True to show the error state; the field alone never decides, so a form adapter sets it from its validation.
props.name: isInvalid

props.description: True to refuse input and show the disabled style; the field leaves the tab order and is left out of the submit.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: True to show the value but refuse changes; unlike disabled, the field keeps focus and is submitted.
props.name: isReadOnly

props.description: The current value, for a controlled field; pair it with `onChange`.
props.name: value

props.description: The starting value, for an uncontrolled field.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: The name the value is submitted under in a form, and the key a form adapter binds.
props.name: name

props.description: The field's accessible name when the label is not a string.
props.name: accessibilityLabel

props.description: Styles the root, as on web.
props.name: className
